sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eba is an obscure Irish heroine. The Book of Invasions names her as a healer. She fell asleep on a shore called Traig Eba. The rising tide drowned her there. She may be the same as Abba. Abba was the companion of Cesair, the first settler to reach Ireland.

okr.objective: Record Eba as an obscure healer whose sleep on Traig Eba ended in drowning.
